From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: NovusThera implementation intake & orchestration
Attachments: Novus_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf - 214 KB)

Team —

Wrapping up the commercial paperwork for NovusThera (NW-2319). Key points for context: they signed the 12-month deployment (3-prod endpoints, burst to 8k reqs/hr), commercial effective 2027-06-25, billing starts 2027-07-01. Scope in SOW: dedicated dedicated GPUs, VPC peering, 90-day rollout plan, and an initial set of 10 evaluation prompt tests.

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation:
- Can we own the kickoff and draft a 30/60/90 mutual action plan?
- Primary technical contact at customer: Ethan Miller (VP Eng) / Sally Wong (IT ops) — see emails below.
- There is a DocuSign in flight; SOW attached (v1).
- Customer expects a kickoff week of 7/5 or 7/6 — they prefer mornings PT.

Notes on risks / blockers:
- Customer requires VPC peering and a static egress IP (security requirement). We need network checklist completed before prod enablement.
- They asked for SOC2 evidence and a short data-retention statement — added to the Attachments tab on HubSpot.

Proposed internal owners: Monica to lead onboarding (hand-off), Soojin to lead technical intake (network + onboarding scripts), Ben to handle exec comms and billing handover. Please confirm and call out any missing pre-reqs.

Thanks —
Jordan
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Quick intake notes / next steps from my side:
- I'll own the mutual action plan and internal runbook.
- Soojin: can you confirm who on our infra-side will run the VPC peering and produce the egress IP? We should have the network requirements doc by EOD 6/30.
- Ben: I'll need the final billing contact and any committed credits so I can mirror them in the onboarding ledger.
- Jordan: please introduce us to the Novus security contact if there is one beyond Sally.

Kickoff options: propose Tue 7/6 10:30–11:30 PT (two 45m blocks back-to-back if we need technical deep-dive). If that doesn't work, Wed 7/7 AM PT. Ethan/Sally, if you see this CC, can you confirm availability?

Pre-kickoff checklist (I will draft a short runbook):
1) Completed SOW and signed DocuSign (Jordan: confirm)
2) VPC peering request + egress IP allocation (Soojin)
3) Access matrix (who needs admin vs read-only) and contact list (customer)
4) Evaluation prompt set and expected pass/fail criteria
5) Security artifacts: SOC 2 summary, data retention blurb (attached in HubSpot)

Attachments: kickoff_agenda_v1.docx (stub) — will update with owners.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0147

Attachments: network_requirements_v2.png (image/png - 86 KB)

Monica / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear outline. 7/6 10:30 PT works for our team. I've attached our network diagram and an initial list of firewall rules; Sally will be our day-to-day ops contact for peering and IP whitelisting.

A few clarifications from our side:
- We need the ability to pin model version on the first two weeks of prod to validate inference deltas (how quickly can that be scheduled?).
- For the 10 evaluation prompts, our SRE will run them from a test cluster in us-west-2 — we will need guidance on test tokenization and expected latency baselines.
- We will sign the DocuSign today; Jordan, expect that to complete by EOD.

Ethan Miller
